explication: Kimi K3 in C is a CPU inference engine for loading and running a very large checkpoint with a bounded resident working set. The principal workflow is: CLI accepts a prompt, tokenizes it, prepares model weights and memory-backed state, runs inference, then returns generated text. Chat adds XTML formatting and multi-turn history; the README also documents incremental decoding, state resume, and draft/verify hybrid decoding. The graph uses documented capabilities where source excerpts are incomplete; it omits uncertain internal call links rather than asserting them.
